intro: Wave kaomoji (also spelled kamoji) are Japanese-style text faces raising a hand to wave — a cheerful hello or a fond goodbye. A wave kaomoji such as (^-^)/ or ( ﾟ▽ﾟ)/ is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into bios, captions, comments, and chats. Browse by style below and click any face to copy it instantly. Whether you search "wave kaomoji" or "kaomoji wave," every face here is free to copy and paste.
